canonicalBuildEnvironment: Linux VM109 (Debian 13.7), Git 2.47.3; both git archive commands were repeated there with identical SHA-256. Git for Windows 2.55 produced different tar bytes for the same commits and is not the canonical archive builder.

productCandidate.functions: Accepted P0-P6 and GEOAI-029 plus bounded DXF result fix; excludes GEOAI-030 experiments and later unfinished functions

operationalPackage.compatibility: Allowlisted exact new archive while retaining 79528bb and P6 rollback; MemoryMax=2560M. Existing private TLS template unchanged.

dependencies.stateSchema: auth SQLite user_version 1; project SQLite user_version 8; no migration

installation: With both services stopped, verify archive bytes/SHA and Git parent, preserve the old config/unit/overlay and an offline backup, extract the product to its commit-named release directory, install the separately versioned pilot_ops package, point config release_commit/archive_path/release_root to the new commit and an isolated synthetic state, install its service unit, run geoai_pilot_ops check as the service user, then start only for bounded technical acceptance. Keep the existing private Caddy/NetBird/DNS/firewall configuration. Restore the old config/unit/overlay and stop both services after the session.
rollback: Original 79528bb tar and 7f5bbec overlay remain unchanged. Keep the original primary state separate because old 25 MiB readers cannot accept new 96 MiB results; do not roll an enlarged result into that state. Restore original config/unit/overlay, verify exact release and leave app/TLS stopped.
